subject.units_status: Provisional: Azure Kinect SDK convention and numerical scale; CSV has no header.
subject.joint_order_status: Provisional standard Azure Kinect 32-joint XYZ order.
subject.fps_status: Camera rate supplied by user; original timestamps and dropped-frame information absent.

screening.note: Exploratory review flags, not physiological limits, automatic exclusions, or fall labels.

subject.metadata_source: Subject sex, weight and height supplied 2026-09-26; activity labels and 30 FPS inherited from user-described collection protocol. Age not supplied; adult coefficient model applicability should be confirmed.

confirmations.coordinate_provenance: Original Azure Kinect joint positions; only leading/trailing frames trimmed for sensor synchronization. No normalization, retargeting, rescaling or padding reported.
confirmations.age_group: Young participants are adults older than 20; individual ages not supplied.
confirmations.timing_note: Nominal collection rate only; timestamps and confidence unavailable. Trimmed offsets unknown.
confirmations.interpretation: Repeated rows and shared limb-length variation remain empirical observations. No preprocessing cause is inferred from these observations.

excluded_trials.S43A10T01: User-directed exclusion: 180 identical initial rows; only three distinct poses in 182 rows.

selection.status: Candidate selection only; other trials are not automatically approved for training. Full audit retains all 25 files.
